mapper.select: SELECT * FROM employee_transfer_history WHERE employee_id = #{employeeId} ORDER BY transfer_date DESC, id DESC

SELECT h.id, h.employee_id AS employeeId, h.transfer_app_id AS transferAppId, h.from_department_id AS fromDepartmentId, fd.name AS fromDepartmentName, h.to_department_id AS toDepartmentId, td.name AS toDepartmentName, h.from_position_id AS fromPositionId, fp.name AS fromPositionName, h.to_position_id AS toPositionId, tp.name AS toPositionName, h.transfer_date AS transferDate, h.reason FROM employee_transfer_history h LEFT JOIN department fd ON fd.id = h.from_department_id AND fd.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN department td ON td.id = h.to_department_id AND td.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN position fp ON fp.id = h.from_position_id AND fp.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN position tp ON tp.id = h.to_position_id AND tp.deleted = 0 WHERE h.employee_id = #{employeeId} ORDER BY h.transfer_date DESC, h.id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO employee_transfer_history (employee_id, transfer_app_id, from_department_id, to_department_id, from_position_id, to_position_id, transfer_date, reason) VALUES (#{employeeId}, #{transferAppId}, #{fromDepartmentId}, #{toDepartmentId}, #{fromPositionId}, #{toPositionId}, #{transferDate}, #{reason})
